## Course Design & Materials

[Introduction to Computational Mathematics](https://apurvanakade.github.io/courses/computational-math/), JHU, 2026

- A proof-based numerical analysis course on a free online textbook, with Jupyter notebook assignments and a group final project in place of a final exam

[Visual Math Lab](https://www.visualmathlab.com/), 2025-Present

- A growing collection of interactive visualizations for teaching and learning mathematics

[AMS Course Explorer](https://apurvanakade.github.io/AMS-courses/), JHU, 2025

- An app for navigating the prerequisite graph of Applied Math & Statistics courses

[Monte Carlo Methods](https://apurvanakade.github.io/Monte-Carlo-Methods/), JHU, 2025

- An online textbook for a semester-long course on simulation, sampling and MCMC

Discrete Mathematics redesign, JHU, 2023-Present

- Homework resubmissions, frequent online assessments and restructured exams, built around an adapted open textbook

[Introduction to Optimization](https://apurvanakade.github.io/Introduction-to-Optimization/), Northwestern, 2022

- Course notes in R Markdown and Excel modeling assignments for a course on linear programming and duality, rebuilt around applications

Open Textbook for Linear Algebra, Northwestern, 2022

- WeBWorK problem sets for a PreTeXt open educational resources textbook

[Algebraic Topology](https://github.com/apurvnakade/uwo2021-algebraic-topology/tree/main/output), UWO, 2021

- Problem sets for a graduate course on the fundamental group, covering spaces and singular homology

Formalizing mathematics in Lean, 2020

- Contributions to mathlib's surreal numbers and convex optimization libraries

[Discrete Structures for Engineering](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLXAOfwfSuiKm3cL-JftD9ndrjYi7fPcqN), UWO, 2020

- Rebuilt for fully asynchronous delivery: weekly video lectures, hundreds of WeBWorK problems written as a team, and a Piazza forum; presented at a conference on e-assessment in the mathematical sciences

[Honors Single Variable Calculus](https://github.com/apurvnakade/jhu2017-18-honors-single-variable-calculus), JHU, 2017-2018

- Two semesters of calculus in one, taught inquiry-based in a flipped classroom

Intersession courses for non-math majors, JHU, 2017-2018

- [Symmetries & Polynomials](https://github.com/apurvnakade/jhu2018-symmetries-and-polynomials/blob/main/output/index.pdf): from group theory to the unsolvability of the quintic
- [Hitchhiker's Guide to Algebraic Topology](https://apurvanakade.github.io/courses/2017_h2g2_alg_top/index.html): algebraic topology and its applications

Canada/USA Mathcamp courses, 2017-2026

- Week-long courses for advanced high school students, including Theorem Proving in Lean, How to Discover the Bell Curve, Riemann Surfaces, Covering Spaces and Cohomology via Sheaves
